thread:
Leah: Thanks everyone for coming to today's all-hands — quick follow-ups, links, and who-owns-what. Recording + slides here: https://redwood.example/ah-2026-03-22 (recording), https://redwood.example/slides-03-22.pdf
Leah: Top clarifications from Q&A: Dedicated capacity GA is targeted for late Q3 (internal beta in July). Private/VPC improvements will be iterated in parallel; details below.
Samir: Quick question re: the cost optimizer feature — will it be opt-in per-tenant or global by default?
Leah: Opt-in per-tenant initially. We don't flip it globally without customer opt-in. The rollout plan is canary -> gradual ramp -> opt-in-bump.
Priya: Who's owning the docs update for the opt-in flow? Need exact UI text for the billing page.
Marco: I'll own the docs + UI copy. Will put a PR up next week.
Cathy: I'll add console telemetry hooks for the feature flags (will surface per-tenant opt-in status on the Billing page).
Eli: Timeline check: on-prem package roadmap looked like "air-gapped support in H2" — can we be a bit more specific? A rough ETA would help enterprise SRE teams.
Leah: Good call — aiming for an internal alpha in August, public preview in October. That's our current target, pending infra sign-off.
Samir: Can we get the canary rollout policy in writing? small snippet would be helpful for on-call and SRE.
Leah: Sure — copy of current plan below:\n```
rollout_policy:
  stage1: 5% traffic (1 week) — smoke + integration tests
  stage2: 25% traffic (2 weeks) — monitoring + cost regressions
  stage3: 100% (gradual over 1 week) — rollback threshold: 10% error spike or 15% latency increase
```
Leah: SRE/eng please watch the rollout channel during stages. We'll have automatic fallback to previous model variant.
Priya: FYI — I captured the product/engineering Qs in a short doc: https://redwood.example/ah-qna-notes-03-22 (I added owners).
Marco: Adding a note — Marco (docs): update billing UI copy, PR by 2026-03-29
Cathy: Cathy (console): telemetry & flag UI by 2026-04-05
Eli: Eli (private): on-prem alpha infra work by 2026-08-15
Samir: Samir (sre): I'll schedule a runbook review with oncall for rollout stages, meeting invite sent for Monday.
Leah: Action items condensed (short):
 - Docs: billing opt-in copy (owner: Marco) — due 2026-03-29
 - Console: telemetry + UI flag (owner: Cathy) — due 2026-04-05
 - Private: alpha infra (owner: Eli) — due 2026-08-15
 - SRE: rollout runbook + pager thresholds (owner: Samir) — review meeting Mon
Leah: If anyone from leadership wants different wording on the customer-facing lines, ping me directly. Otherwise I'll start PRs to the handbook and the release playbook.

Samir: :thumbsup:
